problem: An exterior angle of a nondegenerate triangle, formed by extending one side, is larger than either opposite interior angle.

proof_idea.original: Bisect a side, extend the joining median by its own length, use congruence and vertical angles; compare the resulting proper subangle with the exterior angle. The selected source notes an additional interior-point assumption.
proof_idea.analytic: Strict extension makes its ray opposite to the original side ray. Derive strict normalized-cosine inequalities from nondegenerate coordinate geometry and consume checked arccos strict decrease. Preserve both opposite-angle conclusions.

litex_code:
# Book I.16: a triangle's exterior angle is larger than each opposite interior angle.
# Nondegenerate vertices and a proper extended ray are the domains of the displayed angles.
thm proposition_16:
    ? forall a, b, c, d cart(R, R):
        a != b
        a != c
        b != c
        d != c
        $geometry::main::is_triangle(a, b, c)
        $geometry::main::is_on_extension(d, b, c)
        =>:
            ray_angle(a, c, d) > ray_angle(b, a, c)
            ray_angle(a, c, d) > ray_angle(a, b, c)
    by def $geometry::main::is_triangle(a, b, c)
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, c))^2 > 0
    release thm geometry::main::triangle_det_squared_vertex(a, b, c)
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(b, a), geometry::main::vec(b, c))^2 = geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, c))^2 > 0
    by contra:
        ? geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(b, a), geometry::main::vec(b, c)) != 0
        geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(b, a), geometry::main::vec(b, c)) = 0
        geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(b, a), geometry::main::vec(b, c))^2 = 0
        impossible geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(b, a), geometry::main::vec(b, c))^2 > 0
    by def $geometry::main::is_triangle(b, a, c)
    release thm two_internal_triangle_cosines_sum_positive(a, b, c)
    release thm two_internal_triangle_cosines_sum_positive(b, a, c)
    release thm angle_cosine_arms_symmetric(a, c, b)
    angles::angle_cosine(a, b, c) + angles::angle_cosine(a, c, b) = angles::angle_cosine(a, b, c) + angles::angle_cosine(b, c, a) > 0
    by def $geometry::main::is_on_extension(d, b, c)
    obtain t from exist coef R st {coef > 1, d(1) = (1 - coef) * b(1) + coef * c(1), d(2) = (1 - coef) * b(2) + coef * c(2)}
    have k R+ = t - 1
    d(1) - c(1) = ((1 - t) * b(1) + t * c(1)) - c(1) = -(t - 1) * (b(1) - c(1)) = -k * (b(1) - c(1))
    d(2) - c(2) = ((1 - t) * b(2) + t * c(2)) - c(2) = -(t - 1) * (b(2) - c(2)) = -k * (b(2) - c(2))
    release thm negative_ray_scale_changes_cosine_sign(a, c, b, d, k)
    angles::angle_cosine(b, a, c) = (angles::angle_cosine(b, a, c) + angles::angle_cosine(a, c, b)) - angles::angle_cosine(a, c, b) > 0 - angles::angle_cosine(a, c, b) = -angles::angle_cosine(a, c, b) = angles::angle_cosine(a, c, d)
    angles::angle_cosine(a, b, c) = (angles::angle_cosine(a, b, c) + angles::angle_cosine(a, c, b)) - angles::angle_cosine(a, c, b) > 0 - angles::angle_cosine(a, c, b) = -angles::angle_cosine(a, c, b) = angles::angle_cosine(a, c, d)
    release thm angle_cosine_bounded(a, c, d)
    release thm angle_cosine_bounded(b, a, c)
    release thm angle_cosine_bounded(a, b, c)
    release thm arccos_strictly_decreasing(angles::angle_cosine(a, c, d), angles::angle_cosine(b, a, c))
    release thm arccos_strictly_decreasing(angles::angle_cosine(a, c, d), angles::angle_cosine(a, b, c))
    ray_angle(a, c, d) = arccos(angles::angle_cosine(a, c, d)) > arccos(angles::angle_cosine(b, a, c)) = ray_angle(b, a, c)
    ray_angle(a, c, d) = arccos(angles::angle_cosine(a, c, d)) > arccos(angles::angle_cosine(a, b, c)) = ray_angle(a, b, c)
